items.question: Kto może zatwierdzać samodzielnie?
items.text:
Dokumenty nie mówią wprost, kto może zatwierdzać samodzielnie, ale opisują działania przypisane pojedynczym rolom. Duty Manager może zmieniać kolejność feederów w obrębie tego samego priorytetu i zapisuje powód. [1] Duty Manager równoważy też załogi między punktami zbiórki w paśmie tolerancji. [2] Water Incident Lead zleca podłączenie przenośnych generatorów. [3] Logistics Section Chief przydziela paliwo dla generatorów wodnych na prośbę Water Incident Lead. [4] Decyzje międzydziedzinowe wymagają Incident Commander i Water Incident Lead [5], a prośby o pomoc wzajemną Incident Commander i Logistics Section Chief. [6]

[3] GEP 03.020 Rev D, 3.0 POSITION DESCRIPTIONS, pp. 1-3: "a. Orders portable-generator hookups per WDS 03.318."
[4] GEP 03.020 Rev D, 3.0 POSITION DESCRIPTIONS, pp. 1-3: "d. Assigns fuel deliveries for water-system generators on request of the Water Incident Lead."
[5] DOM 14.215 Rev E, 6.0 PROCEDURE, pp. 2-3: "6.3.2 The decision is approved by the Incident Commander and the Water Incident Lead."
[6] MAL 05.012 Rev C, 6.0 PROCEDURE; 7.0 RECORDS; 8.0 REFERENCES; ATTACHMENT B - CONTACT ROSTER, pp. 2-5: "6.3.1 Mutual-assistance requests are approved by the Incident Commander and the Logistics Section Chief before release to SEE."

items.question: What is a boil-water notice?
items.text:
The documents give no formal definition of a boil-water notice; WQC 07.120 only points to the South Carolina regulation for the definition [1]. In practice, it is a public notice telling customers in an area to boil water used for drinking and cooking [2]. The Water Compliance Officer decides on it with the Water Incident Lead [3]. In Georgia the equivalent is a boil water advisory under WQC 07.114.

Sources:
[1] WQC 07.120 Rev C, 1.0 PURPOSE; 2.0 SCOPE; 3.0 RESPONSIBILITIES; 7.0 RECORDS; 8.0 REFERENCES; ATTACHMENT A NOTICE WORDING (SOUTH CAROLINA), pp. 1-4: "SC R.61-58 (definition 15); SC R.61-58.7.E(7) WDS 03.105; WDS 03.420; WQC 07.114; WQC 07.130; PCN 02.032; F-WQC-031"
[2] WQC 07.120 Rev C, Control box; 7.0 RECORDS; 8.0 REFERENCES; ATTACHMENT A NOTICE WORDING (SOUTH CAROLINA), pp. 1-4: "Due to [cause], customers of SGW in the following area should boil water used for drinking and cooking: [streets and zone]."
[3] WQC 07.120 Rev C, 1.0 PURPOSE; 2.0 SCOPE; 3.0 RESPONSIBILITIES; 7.0 RECORDS; 8.0 REFERENCES; ATTACHMENT A NOTICE WORDING (SOUTH CAROLINA), pp. 1-4: "Water Compliance Officer: decides on the BWN with the Water Incident Lead. Notifies SCDES. Requests release of the notice."
